analyst.summary: [DATA] Bank of India: FY26 standalone PAT Rs.10,527cr; GNPA down to 1.98% / NNPA 0.56% (Mar-26) from 3.27%/0.82% a year ago, improving each of the last two quarters; CRAR 18.01%; RoA 1.01%. CEO tenure extended to 2029 (overhang resolved); govt stake 73.38%, not facing forced SEBI-float dilution unlike some PSU peers. Trades at P/E ~6.3x, P/B ~0.74x. Q1FY27 (Jun-26) full results PENDING as of 20-Jul-2026; provisional business update shows advances +18.64% YoY, deposits +14.92% YoY. [INFERENCE] Asset-quality improvement tracks a sector-wide PSU-bank pattern of falling slippages/write-offs (genuine cycle, not obviously one-off) but BOI-specific slippage/recovery composition and NIM/CASA were not disclosed in sources checked - data gaps, not red flags.
